function.name: calculate_lcm
function.description: Calculate the least common multiple (lcm) between two integers. Unlike calculate_gcd, which calculates the greatest common divisor (gcd), this calculates the least common multiple (lcm).

num1.description: First number to calculate lcm for.

num2.description: Second number to calculate lcm for.

method.description: The specific method to use in the calculation. Supported values: 'standard', 'reduced'. Default 'standard'

function.name: calculate_gcd
function.description: Calculate the greatest common divisor (gcd) between two integers. Unlike calculate_lcm, which calculates the least common multiple (lcm), this calculates the greatest common divisor (gcd).

num1.description: First number to calculate gcd for.

num2.description: Second number to calculate gcd for.

algorithm.description: The specific algorithm to use in the calculation. Default 'euclidean'
